description: [Free] Reads this account. The full status of a render: phase and progress while it runs (with poll_after_seconds), then the files, length, credits, warnings and quality; on a free film, `upgrade` to relay once. `status` is one of, in pipeline order: draft, queued, analyzing, scripting, recording, voicing, rendering, held, done, error. In flight, so poll again after poll_after_seconds: queued, analyzing, scripting, recording, voicing, rendering. Terminal, so stop polling: held, done, error — a cancelled render ends as error with the reason in `error`, and a film can be done and still carry warnings. held: finished but unpublished by quality_gate. draft has not been queued.
name: get_video

ai_report.description: AI visuals: scenes_ai, generated, failed, skipped_budget, credits_spent and credits_refunded (both gross; credits_net is the cost), failures[], note. credits_spent 0 with generated scenes is correct on an account not charged for generation.

callback.description: Last webhook delivery: event_id, status, delivered, attempts, last_http_status, refused.

credits.description: render, ai_clips, ai_images, other, refunded, total (charged minus refunded).

formats.description: Every shape: video_id, aspect_ratio, status, primary, video_url.

length_report.description: Why the film is this length: words, measured_wpm, voice_ms, action, rewrite ("skipped-authored": you wrote the words, so a re-render returns the same length), tempo (1 = untouched), final_gap_pct, speech_ms, speech_wpm. Budget words against speech_wpm, never measured_wpm.

models_used.description: Per generated visual: scene, kind, model, reason.

quality.description: {score, issues[]}: a lead, not a verdict.

resolved.description: Per option: {value, from}; list_options.inheritance names both.

sync_report.description: Only when scenes are off: tolerance_s, scenes_off, worst_drift_s, scenes[] {scene, scene_id, narration_s, visual_s, drift_s, words}.

upgrade.description: Free account's finished film: message plus checkout offers (clean_export, plan, pack_single, ai_film). Relay once.

voice_picked.description: true when the voice was chosen by PageToVid (voice "auto"), false when the caller named it.
